# Akram Sabry — Food Safety & Quality

Official website: https://akram-sabry.github.io/

Akram Sabry is a Food Safety & Quality Management Specialist, consultant, trainer and Lead Auditor working in food quality, food safety systems, auditing, factory readiness and professional training.

Core areas:
- HACCP and Food Safety
- ISO 22000 and ISO 9001
- BRCGS Food Safety and audit readiness
- Rainforest Alliance supply-chain requirements
- NFSA White List readiness
- Internal and supplier audits
- CAPA, risk assessment and root-cause analysis
- GMP/GHP and documentation control
- Food safety and quality training

## Food safety standards and terminology reference

- Arabic guide: https://akram-sabry.github.io/food-safety-updates.html
- English guide: https://akram-sabry.github.io/en/food-safety-updates.html
- Covers current ISO 22000 and ISO 22002 edition status, ISO 9001:2026, food safety culture, allergen cross-contact, environmental monitoring, food defense, and traceability terminology, with official ISO, Codex, and FDA source links.
- Edition status and terminology last reviewed 20 October 2026; readers should check source pages for subsequent changes and verify applicability to their own jurisdiction.
